title: A flashing check engine light is not the same warning as a steady one
negativePromptStanding: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles

beats.visual: A bare amber trouble lamp hanging on its hook over a dark engine bay, pulsing on and off in a fast rhythm, deep shadows, shallow depth of field, 9:16 vertical framing
beats.motion: slow drift in, lamp swaying slightly
beats.narration: Check engine light flashing, or steady?

beats.visual: Macro across a scaled exhaust manifold in a dim engine bay, faint heat shimmer over the metal, an ignition coil seated on the valve cover behind it, orange rim light, 9:16 vertical framing
beats.narration: Flashing usually means a misfire dumping raw fuel.

beats.visual: Under-car shot of the catalytic converter housing, blued and heat scorched steel, haze rising off the shell, 9:16 vertical framing
beats.motion: tilt up from the tailpipe along the exhaust
beats.narration: That raw fuel can cook the catalytic converter.

beats.visual: Low tracking shot of a tire rolling off asphalt onto a gravel shoulder, dust settling as it comes to rest, late daylight, 9:16 vertical framing
beats.motion: tracking shot slowing to a stop
beats.narration: Ease off the gas and skip the highway.

beats.visual: Wide shop bay interior, a car parked beside an empty lift, tools racked in shadow, bay door open to daylight, static hold, 9:16 vertical framing
beats.narration: Steady is different, worth checking soon.
